question: Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Awards-2022, which was presented by President of India Droupadi Murmu on 30th November 2022, was given to _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sharath Kamal.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award** is the highest sporting honor in India, named after the legendary hockey player Major Dhyan Chand.
 
• It was instituted in **1991-92.**
 
• **Sharath Kamal is a table tennis player from Tamil Nadu, India.**
 
• He has represented India at the **Olympics.**
 
• **He received the Padma Shri, India's fourth-highest civilian honor, in 2019 and the Khel Ratna Award, India's greatest sporting honor, in 2022.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Venkatesh Prasad is a former Indian cricketer who played as a right-arm medium-fast bowler.**

 
 
• He has also served as the **bowling coach** of the Indian cricket team.
 
 
 
• **Deepika Kumari is an Indian archer who has won several national and international medals.**
 
 
• She has represented India at the** Olympics **and is currently ranked **world number 1** in women's recurve archery. 
 
 
 
• **Manpreet Singh is an Indian field hockey player.**
 
 
• He has** captained **the Indian men's national team.
